summary.text: Eugene Allison is an independent write-in candidate for the Georgia House of Representatives, District 134, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia also lists Allison as a Republican candidate for Georgia State Senate District 18, where he lost the special general election on January 20, 2026, and the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
